content.trans: 哦，你好，保罗。

content.text: How are you?
content.trans: 你好吗？

content.text: I've got some good news.
content.trans: 我有一些好消息。

content.text: I'm getting a promotion.
content.trans: 我得到了晋升。

content.text: Congratulations.
content.trans: 祝贺。

content.text: How can I would just say that you were the best person for the job?
content.trans: 你可以说，你是最适合这份工作的那个人吗？

content.text: Yes.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: You're the best.
content.trans: 你是最棒的。

content.text: Okay, we're back.
content.trans: 好的，我们又回来了。

content.text: So office gossip is generally, well, it's common.
content.trans: 所以办公室八卦通常，嗯，是常见的。

content.text: It happens in every office.
content.trans: 它发生在每一个办公室里。

content.text: But I think that it's good to avoid too much gossip.
content.trans: 但我觉得，避免太多流言蜚语挺好的。

content.text: Because sometimes people's feelings can get hurt.
content.trans: 因为有时候人们的情感可能会受伤。

content.text: Yeah, it's actually very interesting.
content.trans: 是的，这其实挺有意思的。

content.text: Because usually the bigger the company is, I think more gossip starts to spread.
content.trans: 因为通常来说，公司越大，我觉得八卦就开始多了。

content.text: Because they're departments.
content.trans: 因为他们是部门。

content.text: So you got the marketing department, the finance department.
content.trans: 所以，你连市场部和财务部都管起来了。

content.text: So you're like, oh, Kathy from finance, she slept with Tom from marketing.
content.trans: 所以你是说，像财务部的凯西，她和市场部的小汤睡过。

content.text: And stuff like that.
content.trans: 那啥。

content.text: Then you have the gossip about bosses.
content.trans: 然后你就有老板的八卦。

content.text: Right.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: Did you see?
content.trans: 你看到了吗？

content.text: He totally left for the weekend, but his wife was at home.
content.trans: 他整个周末都出去了，但他的妻子在家。

content.text: Yeah, so.
content.trans: 是的。

content.text: And also one of the situations where a lot of rumors and office gossip starts to come up
content.trans: 而且，也是谣言和办公室八卦开始泛起的一个情况。

content.text: is office parties or the office Christmas parties where people maybe are drinking
content.trans: 是办公室聚餐还是办公室圣诞节聚会，人们可能在喝？

content.text: or something happens and a lot of rumors start to spread.
content.trans: 或者发生了什么情况，谣言就会开始四处传播。

content.text: And they're more relaxed than usual.
content.trans: 他们比平时更放松。

content.text: I think they would normally do.
content.trans: 我觉得他们通常会这样做。

content.text: Absolutely.
content.trans: 绝对。

content.text: So maybe we could open this up to you.
content.trans: 所以也许我们可以让你参与进来。

content.text: Is there a common rumor or office gossip that you hear in your office?
content.trans: 你办公室里有没有听说的共同谣言或者同事间的闲话？

content.text: Or is there that one secretary or guy that's always spreading rumors and gossiping?
content.trans: 或者，是不是总有那么一个总是传谣言、八卦的人？

content.text: And don't use any real names.
content.trans: 和不要使用任何真实的名字。

content.text: You could just tell us general stories.
content.trans: 你只需要告诉我们一些一般的故事。

content.text: But that's about it for us here today at EnglishPod.
content.trans: 但今天在英语有道，就到此为止了。

content.text: Hope you've enjoyed this.
content.trans: 希望你已经享受了这个。

content.trans: 快来访问我们的网站，EnglishPod.com。

content.text: Let us know if you have any questions or concerns.
content.trans: 让我们知道你有任何问题或担忧。
